set.body:
Found in review of the fixture off-screen fix (studio-fixture-offscreen 5f05248). TrialFixation carries only WindowSide; FakeNavigator strips ScreenPlacement (FakeNavigator.scala:199). When the trial view is wired to real data (S3.7 / S6.x), an off-screen fixation will render as WindowSide.Outside, which cannot express core's OutsideScreen vs OutsideWindow(Include) distinction: under an Include policy an off-window fixation is in the map, an off-screen one never is; DroppedInitial also takes precedence in core's MapPlacement.

Acceptance: TrialFixation (or its view-model) carries core's placement (DroppedInitial / OutsideScreen / OutsideWindow / Inside) end to end; trial view renders each distinctly per DESIGN_SPEC; a test with an Include policy shows an off-window fixation counted in the map and an off-screen one not. Must land before S3.7 closes.
set.title: Carry core fixation placement (OutsideScreen vs OutsideWindow, DroppedInitial) through TrialFixation
